SY218
Constructions of Deviance
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
An analysis of the social construction of deviance, social control and the use of social rules. Particular constructions of deviance to be addressed may include mental illness, juvenile delinquency, interpersonal violence and substance abuse.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
Registration Status: Senior Student
Exclusions
CC401
, SY318*.
